answer: The issue with attributing a 10-hour daily driving period that starts on Sunday and ends on Monday to a specific week in Regulation (EC) no 561/2006 is that the regulation is underspecified regarding which week the extended daily driving time should be attributed. The week is defined as starting on Monday at 00:00 and ending on Sunday at 24:00. Therefore, it is unclear whether the driving time should be attributed to the week containing the Sunday when the driving started or to the week containing the Monday when the driving ended. This ambiguity leads to uncertainty in compliance with the regulation.
